column2: Jev tracked human concreteness at r = 0.90 and valence at r = 0.88, but arousal at r = 0.61; rewording did not repair arousal.
On the stated probability-format problems, Jev was correct on 288 of 288 calls.

Rated alone, it scored the conjunction above its part; shown side by side, it picked the conjunction on none. anchored on unknowable quantities, showed outcome bias, and showed recency rather than primacy.
It ranked the 999 pairs like people, r = 0.854 [0.841, 0.868], while using lower numeric levels.
Touch was strongest, r = 0.783 [0.745, 0.818]; interoception was weakest, r = 0.494 [0.431, 0.557].

A 64-neuron worm slice saturated and failed as a behavioural test; silent inputs leaked when mixed with active ones, a separate inactive-input list fixed that leak, and edited sentences were followed 88–90% of the time.
